08.01.2025 Heard Ms. M. Saikia, learned counsel for the appellant.

This appeal under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 is directed against the judgment and award dated 12.09.2024 passed by the learned Member, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal (MACT),
Morigaon, in MAC (Death) Case No.26/2019.

It is to be noted here that vide impugned judgment and award dated 12.09.2024, the learned Member, MACT, Morigaon, has directed the appellant herein to pay a sum of Rs.24,25,089/- being the compensation to the claimant with interest at @6%
per annum from the date of filing the claim petition i.e. 12.03.2019 till realization.
Page No.# 3/3 Perused the memo of appeal and the grounds mentioned therein and also perused the impugned judgment and award dated 12.09.2024.
Admit.

Let notice be issued to the respondent, returnable within 4(four) weeks.
Step be taken by registered post with A/D and also by usual process within a week from today.
